svg.title: Дровосек на нижнем блоке — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Standing LOW-TO-HIGH diagonal cable woodchop. Tower is off to athlete's side, pulley located just above floor. A single continuous cable connects the bottom circular pulley to one D handle held by both hands together. LEFT hands start low outside the hip nearest tower with soft knees and slight hip turn. RIGHT hands finish diagonal UP across the body beyond the OPPOSITE shoulder at head height, arms extended naturally and torso turns with hips. In the right phase the cable visibly crosses the entire body from LOW pulley to HIGH hands. Same floor pulley in both panels, no cable from top. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
